transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm seeking help because I've been struggling a lot with focusing and getting easily distracted lately. On top of that, I just feel constantly restless and can't seem to settle down.
Have you struggled with these focus and restlessness issues since you were a child, or is this something that started more recently?

I've actually had these struggles with focus and restlessness since I was a kid, definitely before I was 12 years old. But they've become much more noticeable and have really started impacting my life over the last year and a half.
When you feel restless, is it mostly physical—like needing to fidget, move around, or acting impulsively—or is it more of an internal state of constant worry or racing thoughts?

It is definitely more of a physical feeling rather than worry or anxiety. I constantly feel this urge to move, tap my feet, or fidget with whatever is in my hands. It just feels like my body has a hard time staying still.
Have you ever experienced distinct periods lasting days or weeks where you felt extremely down and depressed, or times when you felt unusually high, energetic, and didn't need much sleep?
No, I haven't really experienced anything like that. I don't have those kinds of extreme mood swings, and I've never felt unusually high or deeply depressed for periods of time.

Besides having trouble focusing and being physically restless, do you also frequently struggle with things like losing important items, forgetting daily tasks, or interrupting others in conversations?

Yes, I actually lose important things all the time, like my keys or my wallet, and it is so frustrating to constantly misplace things I need. As for forgetting daily tasks or interrupting others, those don't really seem to be major issues for me.
Do you often feel like you are constantly 'on the go' as if driven by a motor, talk excessively, or find it very difficult to wait your turn in lines or situations?

I don't really feel like I'm 'driven by a motor' or talk excessively, but I definitely have a constant, uncomfortable feeling of inner restlessness. And yes, I find it incredibly difficult to wait my turn in lines or other situations.
Do you often make careless mistakes at work or school, struggle to organize your tasks and schedule, or avoid things that require a lot of mental effort?

I definitely make a lot of careless mistakes and struggle to pay close attention to details at work, which has been a major issue for me. I'm not really sure about struggling with organization or avoiding mental tasks, but the mistakes on details happen all the time.
Do you often find it hard to keep your attention focused during long tasks, like lengthy meetings or reading, or do you frequently start projects but fail to finish them?
I haven't really noticed that being a specific problem for me. I'm not quite sure if I struggle with finishing projects or keeping my focus during long meetings.
Do you find yourself leaving your seat in situations where you are expected to stay seated, or do you tend to blurt out answers before a question has been fully asked?
No, I don't really struggle with leaving my seat when I'm expected to stay seated. I also don't tend to blurt out answers before someone has finished asking their question.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by external stimuli, or do you struggle to listen when spoken to directly?

Yes, I am incredibly easily distracted by almost anything around me, like background noises, movement, or even my own unrelated thoughts jumping in. As for struggling to listen when someone is speaking directly to me, I'm not really sure about that.
